ala.text: In Shards of Alara, an unknown planeswalker tears the single plane of Alara asunder millennia ago, harvesting its mana in the Sundering.
The disaster breaks Alara along color lines into five shards, which recover their mana only in part.

Each shard becomes a world defined as much by what mana it lacks as by what flows in it, and Grixis, which lost access to white and green mana, was once connected to the others and flush with life before becoming a world of death.
Centuries later the obelisks still serve forgotten purposes, and Bolas's influence grows as Grixis falls under his sway while Esper ignores him until too late.

con.text: In Conflux, Alara's shards complete their merging and the plane is whole again, as Nicol Bolas foments chaos and destroys the obelisks to speed the process.
As Grixis collides with the rest of Alara, the worlds begin to hear the whispers of the forgotten dead, and the shards reunite as a patchwork plane where cultures clash and wars ensue.
The shards' mana fuses into new monstrosities as they merge into the Maelstrom, and the reunification reawakens Progenitus, the Soul of the World.
Bolas's long machinations are about to triumph, and the Maelstrom spawns the Child of Alara, who shows no allegiance or mercy to any of the five shards.

arb.text: In Alara Reborn, Nicol Bolas's plans reach their zenith as the five shards of Alara merge, and the former shards clash and mingle in an inter-shard war.
Esper crushes against Bant and Grixis at their frontiers, where thousands die, and creatures are taken by summoning, mind control and force from one shard to fight in another.

Kings and queens of old Alara return as spectral protectors for soldiers, while the Maelstrom sends a wave of raw mana through a battlefield and entire ways of life vanish without a trace in the collision of the shards.

j25.text: In Foundations Jumpstart, Alara is remembered as the plane whose strength the Conflux showed came from unity, not division.
